name: @loopzhb/server
description: Loop-platform-zhb control plane: scheduling, state, storage and Team-scoped management. GitHub Login Sessions gate the management API and the loopback Dashboard; machines are claimed offline with claim:legacy and poll only as existing eligible rows (no self-registration). Boot requires LOOPZHB_ORIGIN plus LOOPZHB_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID/SECRET. Package exports stay ./db + ./db/schema.

scripts.test: pnpm --filter @loopzhb/protocol build && pnpm --filter @loopzhb/daemon build && vitest run
